contractDecision.predicate: Existing incident attempts must be valid nonnegative safe numeric integers, excluding negative zero, and strictly equal to the original baseline; new incidents require valid numeric zero. Neither observation nor lifecycle readback may start recovery.
contractDecision.primaryEvidence: Original owner directive preserves completed autonomous Assurance recovery and three verified recoveries, canonical history and whole-system rollback state. V49 A5-08/A5-09 require preservation and independent whole-application return readback. Exact producer creates numeric zero, increments genuine admitted attempts, and can preserve historical positive counts through observations.

findings: cpRecord retains attempts inside the incident identity hash. Existing and current counters are validated before same-body early return. Identity, workspace-key, lifecycle, recurrence, time, limitation, recovery-record and authority-record restrictions remain.

Full-row hash multisets for both RECOVERY_ADMITTED and RECOVERY_RESULT are equal to baseline. Existing cp_events full-row inclusion remains. RESULT detects reconciliation that executes without a new admission or count increase.

Initial self-validation runs only in normal phase. Later phases compare against real saved baseline, preserving original and rejected operand digests/types. No malformed unchanged counter bypass remains.

Diagnostic schemas retain closed type/class pairs, hashed identifiers, bounded counts, no raw incident/event contents, first causal failure precedence and source/index/run bindings for both incident and event contexts.

Only three new diagnostic codes were added; old code and frame allowlists were retained. Exporter adds optional source-bound context without changing native success or application acceptance predicates.
No application producer/package, identity or authentication mechanism, PAUSE/REVOKE, drain, generation exclusion, production target or financial authority is changed by this eight-file subset.

The former absolute-zero test on changed existing incidents is replaced only where the original preservation contract positively supports historical counts. It does not permit a new recovery attempt or suppress a changed count.

resolvedReviewFinding.finding: Unconditional current/current self-validation could label a malformed returned operand as its own baseline and claim identity equality.
resolvedReviewFinding.correction: Scope self-validation to normal; compare all later phases against saved original baseline.
resolvedReviewFinding.verification: Executed complete unchanged checker module with synthetic filesystem/SQLite dependencies: valid historical normal baseline PASS, malformed returned operand retained true prior POSITIVE_INTEGER and observed NULL with distinct hashes and identityEqual false, malformed initial normal rejected.

independentTests.notes: VM orchestration uses actual complete checker source and actual helper, with synthetic external dependencies and prototype-insensitive assertion adapter for cross-realm object equality. Initial harness setup mismatches were corrected; no implementation bypass was added.

limitations: Actual V109 attempts value/type remains unrecovered; this does not prove that the demonstrated contract mismatch caused that run.
No native application or hosted examination was executed; A5-08/A5-09 remain NOT PROVEN.
This attests only independent source review; security review is a separate genuine receipt.
Full source/manifests and routing/financial binding review is separate from this diagnostic subset.
